title: Dog Days/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: > “BET LATHUUM... I MEAN... LET RATHUUM BEGIN!

- Kela De Thaym: "Tenno. Sneaky, underhanded, snakey little Tenno. A special Rathuum! Executioners and accused will fight with ACID THROWERS! Ret! Lathuum! Beg...! Bet Lath... *cough* Let! Rathuum! Begin!"

- Kela De Thaym: "Do you smell something? GAS LEAK? Gas leak? That's hilarious. Haha. Wait! Exec... Executioners! Iz such a nice day. Do we really wanna fight? Or... dooo weee wannaaa... PARTY?! WA-TER-RR FIIIGHT! I! Said! WATER FIGHT! WADDAFITE! I want a drink with a pink umbrella in it. WATERFIGHT!"
- "Hosers and Squirts, fill your weapons. Ah stop complaining ya know ya love it."
- "Ah my executioners are all dressed up and ready for fun. Dey look so cute."
- "Are! You! Ready ta GET WET?! Hmm? Sure sure, fix the gas leak, whatever. Don't bother me with details."
- "Alright! Now get out there and show me some H2-WHOO-OA!"
- "3-2-1! I! Order You! To Have! Fun! DING DING DING!"
- "HA ha! My executioners have you hosed, Tenno! D... do you think we're gonna get in trouble for this?"
- "You're all washed up, Tenno! We should solve all our problems like this."
- "Hah, drip, drip you Tenno squirts! Losing team mops up the arena."
- "It's all fun and games until WE START LOSING! Pick up your act, Executioners! Fix the gas leak? Pfft. Y'know, we never really talk."
- "Executioners: If those were still acid cannons, you'd be in a world of hurt right now. HOSE THE TENNO! FOR SQUISHY HONOR!"
- "My mighty executioners, bowing out 'cause they're too wet? Are you even Grineer? Pfft."
- "Round over! Mop'em down and wrap it up!"
- "Round over! Back in your corners and wring out your unmentionables! NEW ROUND!"
- "The only fun to be had in Rathuum, is by me, watching you, DIE. Why has nobody DIED? Oh. Right."
- "Bah! So you won this one. Best out of... how many have... LET'S DO IT AGAIN, MEATSACKS!"

- "Well, well, well. Even with all your underhanded Tenno gas leak trickery and slippery weapon-swappery and... and... stuff... Still, mighty Grineer conditioning WINS THE DAY! KE-LA'S NUMBER ONE! KE-LA'S NUMBER ONE!"

path: Completing the first mission with 25 points
lines: > Alright, so you got lucky. Big deal. BIG HAIRY DEAL. Take this. See you on the beach, squirt.” —Kela De Thaym

path: Completing the second mission with 50 points
lines: > So, two for two. OK. But the third time won't be the charm, squirt. The next time you hit the beach my Executioners are gonna hang you out to dry.” —Kela De Thaym

path: Completing the third mission with 100 points
lines: > OK, so I've been all friendly-like. Goin' easy on ya. But this has gone on long enough. Final round, squirt. FINAL ROUND. Come an' get it.” —Kela De Thaym

path: Completing the fourth mission with 200 points
lines: > I guess I gotta hand it to ya. You really hosed my crew. Well done, I guess. But jus' remember: they're gonna fix this gas leak at some point and when they do... WHEN THEY DO... it's back to business, buddy. NO MORE MRS NICE ME. Carry on.” —Kela De Thaym
